Name: MyClaw 3.0
Tagline: Build an always-on AI team with shared memory
Description: MyClaw lets you build your own AI team with OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, Hermes Agent, Pi, and more. Give each teammate its own role, tools, skills, and choice of 50+ models, with shared memory across your team. Your agents run on always-on cloud computers, use your apps, access data, and handle recurring tasks even when you're offline. Assign work from the web, Slack, Telegram, or WhatsApp. No server setup or lock-in to a single AI provider.

Name: Canva MCP
Tagline: Turn any AI agent into a creative powerhouse
Description: Canva MCP opens Canva's creative tools to AI agents and developers. Generate editable designs, images and videos, remove backgrounds, resize assets and automate on-brand creative workflows with MCP, REST APIs and CLI.

Name: Airbot
Tagline: The AI chief of staff that texts you first
Description: Most AI assistants wait for you to ask. Airbot texts you first. It checks the conversations, meetings, and customer updates spread across email, Slack, your calendar, and CRM, then brings you only the priorities that matter. Behind every message is work already prepared: a drafted response, a meeting brief, a booking, or a CRM change. Approve what should happen directly in WhatsApp or iMessage. Airbot helps founders and lean teams stay on top of work without living in their notifications.

Name: MAGI-2
Tagline: Sand AI's 480B model for cinematic video generation
Description: MAGI-2 is Sand AI's flagship video generation model, creating up to 30 seconds of 1080p video with synchronized native audio. Combine up to 20 image, video, and audio references to guide characters, scenes, styles, and sound. Direct shot changes and timeline events, or edit specific parts of existing videos. Built for creators who want more control over cinematic AI video production. Available through the Sand AI platform and API.

Name: Snag by Parallel
Tagline: Find the best deals on products from your agents
Description: Find the best deals on the products you've been asking ChatGPT, Claude, and other agents about. Snag turns those conversations into a wishlist you import in one click, matches each item to the exact product, and checks prices across stores. Lists are sorted by best deal, every price is rated against its list price, and any list can be shared with a link. 100% free, in time for Black Friday. Powered by the Parallel Shopping API and Parallel Images API.

Name: Omi X 2.0
Tagline: Click any part of your app and tell Omi what to change
Description: Omi can build anything. Omi X 2.0 is the desktop app for Mac and Windows that builds a production AI SaaS on your own Google Cloud and Firebase. New in 2.0: Point and edit lets you click any part of your running app and tell Omi what to change. Open an existing project brings in your own Next.js app; Omi tests, builds and deploys it. New projects start from a tested starter. Plan free, no card; building from $29 a month.

Name: Tendeck
Tagline: Run all your Claude Code and Codex agents on one Mac board
Description: Every coding agent becomes a card on one board. The card turns gold when an agent needs you, so nothing waits 40 minutes for a "yes". Claude Code, Codex or any agent CLI, with worktrees, account switching and files on the card. $59 once.

Name: RelayRunner
Tagline: Open source router for GitHub Actions runners
Description: Send each GitHub Actions job to the first free runner in your order: your own Mac, self-hosted runners, a hosted provider or GitHub-hosted. Change the order any time without touching your workflows. Open source, with a Mac menu bar app and a CLI that turn any machine into a runner.

Name: Tray
Tagline: macOS file manager in a screen corner
Topics: Productivity, Developer Tools, Menu Bar Apps
Description: A file manager for macOS that lives in a screen corner. Drop files on the shelf, preview them, group them into a folder, drag them anywhere, or send them to the Bin — without opening Finder.

Name: Continual-ARC
Tagline: OpenClaw doesn't learn from experience. Does your agent?
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Left to themselves, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent and Prime Agent failed to memorize puzzles they'd already seen, and didn't get better at solving new ones. In contrast, a small 9B model trained on the same stream got better at both. Run yours on the open benchmark.

Name: Blink
Tagline: Describe any trade and watch Blink build it
Description: "If they announce Jensen is back, long NVDA and short AMD." The news that moves a stock usually lands while you're asleep or in a meeting, and by the time you see it the move is over. Blink is a trading app where you describe any trade in plain English and it builds it, then watches around the clock. It can trigger on a post on X, a headline, an earnings result, a line said on a live earnings call or a shift in prediction market odds, and it places the trade the moment it happens.

Name: Qube
Tagline: An AI agent for anyone with the model of your choice
Topics: Open Source, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub, Tech
Description: Qube is a personal AI assistant that lives on your computer — pick your own AI (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or offline), and your files never leave your machine. Tell it what you need, and it actually does it — makes real files, researches the web, and works inside Gmail, Slack, Notion, and more. You stay in control — it checks with you before sending anything or touching a connected account, and free and open-source to boot.

Name: Hai
Tagline: Your AI assistant that actually makes the phone call
Description: Some bookings still only happen by phone, and plenty of us dread making that call. For people who are deaf, hard of hearing, or have speech or anxiety barriers, that call can be impossible. Hai makes it for you. Tell your assistant what you need, approve the plan, and Hai places the call in any language to any business that takes bookings by phone, then reports back in text. Free to start. Built by an indie developer in Japan.

Name: Fompi
Tagline: Personal security & privacy companion that calls out risks
Description: Fompi sits quietly in your browser and on your Mac, and speaks up when it matters: a scam page, a phishing email, a disguised download, an AI notetaker in your call, an app on your mic, a card number headed for an AI chat. It tells you why. Free to start :)

Name: SteerLatch
Tagline: Connect MCP-compatible AIs to your computer
Description: SteerLatch connects MCP-compatible AIs to your authorized Mac/Windows PC: files, desktop, terminal, STOP and revocable access. NEW: control your paired PC from a phone/browser after local setup, while AI works. SteerLatch Context Hub shares project memory and messages across agents. Official apps are live on Apple App Store (iPhone companion) and Microsoft Store (Windows). Free 3-month trial: 3 PCs, 5,000 MCP calls/month, no card.

Name: Falcon by Vybe
Tagline: Falcon analyzes your competitors for free, then gets to work
Description: Get a free competitor analysis. Falcon, a Vybe agent, digs into your rivals and delivers a deep report: market landscape, feature parity, momentum, gaps left open, and competitors' go-to-market motions. The whole picture, not just a list of competitors. Want more than the report? Falcon runs on Vybe, so you can let an agent take the wheel, keep you updated on where the market is headed and turn the findings into work.

Name: eluna
Tagline: Period tracker for couples that explains WHY, not just WHEN
Description: most period trackers are a calendar with a countdown. eluna tells you WHY. a one minute check in and it writes a line from her own data: why day 24 feels heavy, why the bloating is back, what's coming next. ask eluna anything and it answers from her history, not a leaflet. then the part made for couples: partner mode gives him a heads up before the harder days, not after the fight. iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch, 7 languages, free to start, built by a husband and wife

Name: Koed
Tagline: Supercharged Agents!
Description: Koed gives each coding project its own Kin: a customisable assistant that remembers how you like to work, the decisions you’ve made and what you’ve already tried. Your Kin reasons over that context to give Claude Code, Codex and Pi guidance shaped by your project, helping your agents work faster and use fewer tokens. Koed runs on-device and is free and open source. It’s available now for solo developers, with more coding agent integrations, optional cloud processing and team sharing coming soon.

Name: MemoryWorks
Tagline: Company memory for people and AI agents
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: MemoryWorks is the memory layer for engineering organizations. It captures decisions, context and know-how from your team's sources and makes it available to people and AI agents, always tied back to where it came from. Works with ChatGPT and Claude Code via an MCP server. Open source (AGPL-3.0).

Name: Hold'em
Tagline: Swipe real Black Friday cart deals across Shopify
Description: Black Friday usually leaves me with 40 open tabs and fake markdowns. Hold'em turns deal hunting into a quick card game across Shopify, checking live store carts for real automatic discounts and putting your keepers in one bag.
